id.description: A screen name of the vocabulary: one or two kebab-case segments.

title.description: The title of the screen, for a reader.

description.description: What the screen is for: the task it serves and when it is shown.

frame.description: The frame around every screen: it has no route of its own.

path.description: The route path: static segments, `$param`, `{-$param}` (optional) and `$` (splat), from `/`.

guard.description: Who may open the route: only a guest, or only a signed-in account; absent: anyone.

roles.description: The roles that see the element; absent: every role of the screen.

own.description: Shown to a member only on the entries the member owns.

holdsInput.description: Left out, every field (input, textarea, select, checkbox, radio, switch) holds input, except one of whose bindings runs an action that takes the field itself as a parameter and that no other anchor of the screen runs with it: a choice that applies at once. A field a submit button runs the action with holds input.

codes.description: The data-code values the element carries. An error that leaves them out carries the codes of the failures of the actions the anchors of its part bind (`<part>.<name>` beside `<part>.error`), each once, `failed` last.

fields.description: An error's codes, each with the field of the screen it concerns, which the error shows under and marks invalid; a code left out concerns the form. Left out, each code a field of the model gives goes to the control the binding passes for that field, unless two bindings pass two controls.

derived.description: The derived suffixes the element renders: `confirm-button`, `option`.
